svg.title: What one AGV assignment adds to the DAG
svg.desc: Assigning AGV-1 to TrayMove e4 adds AgvMove(to tray), lift, sets agv_id on the TrayMove, and adds lower, with four kinds of dependency edges.
svg.metadata: ["Before: TrayMove e4 (T15: P15 -> P19) is a root of event_dag_copy with no AGV yet. BottleneckAssignment matched it to AGV-1.", "MoveAgvToTrayPose() adds an AgvMove that drives AGV-1 from W26 to the tray pose P15 (it is skipped when the AGV is already there).", "AppendAgvLiftEvent(raised) adds an AgvMove that lifts T15 onto AGV-1, after the drive.", "SetAgvId(AGV-1) fills in the TrayMove itself: e4 now carries T15 to P19 on AGV-1, after the lift.", "AppendAgvLiftEvent(lowered) adds the lower at P19, so AGV-1 is free again after e4.", "Incoming edge 1: AGV-1's previous event (last_agv_event[AGV-1]) must finish before AGV-1 drives off: one chain of events per AGV.", "Incoming edge 2: if a tray stands on AGV-1's navigation path, that tray's first move (ctx->first_tray_event) must clear it first.", "Incoming edge 3: AddNodeArrivalDeps() makes AGV-1's arrival at P15 wait until the previous AGV on that node has left.", "Incoming edge 4: if agv_event_dag says another matched AGV (parent AGV-2) must go first, its last_move_to_tray_event[AGV-2] precedes AGV-1's drive.", "Finally the assignment's event_cost (travel + lift_up + carry + lift_down) is propagated to the children and added to agv_occupied_durations[AGV-1]."]

g.text: Matching only picks pairs; the loop that follows turns each pair into real events and wires them into the DAG so motion planning can replay them safely.
